first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, while prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and reducing required signup fields improved completion, time-to-value, and first-week activation. I would verify both records before committing, then run a guarded test that monitors qualified revenue and lead quality so higher completion does not come at the expense of sustainable value.

final.rationale: Run a standard, segment-aware onboarding simplification experiment this week, prioritizing the proven shortening changes and testing signup-field reductions only for SMBs. The evidence directly addresses both current problems: shortened onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, while SMB signup simplification improved activation and qualified revenue but slightly reduced retention and did not generalize beyond SMB. Gate success on qualified revenue and retention, not completion alone, and keep enterprise flows unchanged.
